idea-plugin.name: IoT Data Notice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Checks a smart-device product data notice against Data Act Article 3(2)-(3) in VS Code

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → IoT Data Notice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/iot-data-notice-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/iot-data-notice-lint

action.text: IoT Data Notice Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run IoT Data Notice Lint on the file in the editor
